components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #f5f6f8; color: #090a0d; height: 48px; padding: 0 28px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e2e4e9; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: WhatsApp Direct Button
components.css: .ds-btn-wa { background: #10b981; color: #032115; height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.84rem; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-wa:hover { background: #14cd92; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Category Filter Pill
components.description: Segmented tab pill for catalog filtering.
components.css: .ds-filter-pill { height: 38px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #12141a; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: #a1a7b5; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter-pill.active { background: #f5f6f8; color: #090a0d; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: Punto Prisma pairs the uncompromising restraint, spatial breathing room, and optical precision of Apple interfaces with the practical commerce realities of Paraguay.

rules.name: The Reserve Accent Rule
rules.body: Emerald green is strictly reserved for conversion, live connectivity, and WhatsApp actions.

rules.name: The Tabular Pricing Rule
rules.body: All prices in Guaraníes (Gs.) must use tabular figures to preserve column alignment.

rules.name: The Zero Chromatic Halo Rule
rules.body: Box shadows must always use neutral alpha masks. Colored glows are forbidden.

dos: Do format all currency figures as Gs. [amount] with dots.
Do use vector SVGs with uniform stroke width.
donts: Don't use gradient text or colored text shadows.
Don't add eyebrows or kickers above section titles.
Don't use emojis as replacements for interface icons.
